kind: bench
depth: focused
-- base/examples/complete/main.tf --
module "this" {
  source = "../.."
  vpc_id = "vpc-1"
  cidr   = "10.0.0.0/24"
}
-- base/main.tf --
data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

resource "aws_subnet" "this" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block        = var.cidr
  availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
}
-- base/outputs.tf --
output "subnet_id" {
  value = aws_subnet.this.id
}
-- base/variables.tf --
variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "cidr" {
  type = string
}

variable "exclude_zone_ids" {
  type    = list(string)
  default = []
}
-- base/versions.tf --
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.7"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.0"
    }
  }
}
-- head/examples/complete/main.tf --
module "this" {
  source = "../.."
  vpc_id = "vpc-1"
  cidr   = "10.0.0.0/24"
}
-- head/main.tf --
data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"

  exclude_zone_ids = var.exclude_zone_ids
}

resource "aws_subnet" "this" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block        = var.cidr
  availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[0]
}
-- head/outputs.tf --
output "subnet_id" {
  value = aws_subnet.this.id
}
-- head/variables.tf --
variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "cidr" {
  type = string
}

variable "exclude_zone_ids" {
  type    = list(string)
  default = []
}
-- head/versions.tf --
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.7"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.0"
    }
  }
}
